description: Two concurrent `Extract` calls for the same `project_path` serialize through an in-process queue (additionally enforced at the Node sidecar layer because `ts-morph` Project state is not safe to share across parallel invocations). Calls for different paths run in parallel.

requirements.description: Concurrent Extract calls targeting the same project_path must serialize through an in-process mutex/queue on the Go API layer, preventing concurrent ts-morph Project state access for the same project. Concurrent Extract calls targeting different project_paths must execute in parallel without artificial serialization. The per-path serialization must be implemented at both the Go API layer (mutex keyed by canonical path) and enforced within the Node sidecar (ts-morph Project state is not thread-safe). The queuing mechanism must not deadlock, must not leak goroutines, and must respect context cancellation.
requirements.title: Per-Path Serialization with Cross-Path Parallelism

validation.notes: Test that two goroutines calling Extract on the same path are serialized (second waits for first to complete)
Test that two goroutines calling Extract on different paths execute concurrently (wall time < sum of sequential times)
Test that a cancelled context releases the per-path lock without blocking subsequent callers
Test that the per-path queue does not deadlock under 100 concurrent same-path requests
Test that goroutine count does not grow unboundedly under repeated concurrent Extract calls
TCG-CONCURRENCY-SAME-PATH: Launch 10 concurrent Extract goroutines against the same fixture path; assert all return identical byte-for-byte results and no data races (run with -race)
TCG-CONCURRENCY-DIFF-PATH: Launch 10 concurrent Extract goroutines across 5 different fixture paths; assert wall time is significantly less than sequential total
TCG-SIDECAR-SERIALIZATION: Verify Node sidecar processes same-path requests sequentially via IPC channel inspection
10 concurrent same-path Extract calls complete within 2x the time of a single sequential call (serialized overhead bound)
No data corruption or inconsistent graph output observed under concurrent load in a 10-minute soak test

title: Per-Path Serialization, Parallel Across Paths
